rationale: C08 is a near-direct template for the child proclamation. It uses the same statutory authority, reciprocal-treatment predicate, two-part definition of covered works, finding of wartime disruption or suspension of facilities, one-year extension, and detailed limitation preserving copyright terms and prior lawful uses. The principal adaptations are the country, reciprocity history, and removal of Australia's ad interim-copyright language. C06 and C03 share analogous extension machinery and much of the disruption/formalities phrasing, but concern trademark renewals under a different statute and are materially less similar.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the President is authorized... to grant an extension of time for fulfillment of the conditions and formalities prescribed by the copyright laws... with respect to works first produced or published outside the United States... by nationals of countries which accord substantially equal treatment
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the President is authorized... to grant an extension of time for fulfillment of the conditions and formalities prescribed by the copyright laws... with respect to works first produced or published outside the United States... by nationals of countries which accord substantially equal treatment
shared_material.explanation: The opening authority recital is substantially identical, including the same title 17 machinery and reciprocity condition.

shared_material.child_excerpt: with respect to (1) works of citizens of Finland which were first produced or published outside the United States... and (2) works of citizens of Finland subject to renewal of copyright... there has existed during several years... such disruption or suspension of facilities essential to compliance
shared_material.parent_excerpt: with respect to (1) works of citizens of Australia which were first produced or published outside the United States... and (2) works of citizens of Australia subject to renewal of copyright... there has existed during several years... such disruption or suspension of facilities essential to compliance
shared_material.explanation: The operative finding follows the same distinctive two-category sequence and uses virtually identical language, substituting Finland for Australia.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the time within which compliance with such conditions and formalities may take place is hereby extended with respect to such works for one year after the date of this proclamation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the time within which compliance with such conditions and formalities may take place is hereby extended with respect to such works for one year after the date of this proclamation
shared_material.explanation: The central legal action is verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the term of copyright in any case is not and cannot be altered or affected... no liability shall attach... for lawful uses made or acts done prior to the effective date... or... the continuance for one year... of any business undertaking or enterprise lawfully entered into
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the term of copyright in any case is not and cannot be altered or affected... no liability shall attach... for lawful uses made or acts done prior to the effective date... or... the continuance for one year... of any business undertaking or enterprise lawfully entered into
shared_material.explanation: The detailed savings clause is reproduced essentially verbatim, strongly demonstrating reuse of a concrete drafting template.
